Hlekisa ngami GPS UnifiedNlp Inkonzo Yendawo
Imvume ye-Signature Level, edingekayo ku-Mock my GPS ukuhlinzeka ngemibuyekezo yendawo kuyo UnifiedNlp Ingxenye yangemuva.
Izindlela zokusetshenziswa "Hlekisa ngami GPS" njengomhlinzeki wendawo we-backend ngenkathi isevisi yayo isebenza.

Inani lamamilisekhondi elengezwe ku-timestamp kuzo zonke izibuyekezo zendawo. Inani elikhulu ngokwanele kumele liqinisekise ukuthi bonke abanye abahlinzeki be-backend bayashiywa ngaphandle ngenkathi i-mocking isebenza.:
